description: How clearly the implementation structure represents the workflow architecture.
observation_method: Inspect code structure, runner behavior, and saved workflow observations after execution.

description: How explicitly the framework controls task order, transitions, and execution boundaries.
observation_method: Compare graph edges, task sequencing, or conversation flow in code and logs.
rating_scale: 1 = implicit or unclear, 5 = explicit and easy to trace

description: How intermediate data is represented, passed, and updated during the workflow.
observation_method: Review state object, task outputs, conversation messages, and execution log.
rating_scale: 1 = hidden or difficult to inspect, 5 = explicit and transparent

description: How easily the implementation can call helper functions or external tools.
observation_method: Inspect where shared formatting, parsing, or model calls are attached to the workflow.
rating_scale: 1 = difficult to integrate, 5 = natural and well supported

description: How the framework represents collaboration between roles, agents, or workflow nodes.
observation_method: Compare node coordination, role-based agents, and conversational multi-agent behavior.
rating_scale: 1 = little coordination support, 5 = clear coordination model

description: How observable the workflow is during development and execution.
observation_method: Review logs, metadata, error handling, and intermediate step visibility.

description: How straightforward the framework is to implement for a small automation task.
observation_method: Reflect on setup steps, amount of framework-specific code, and friction during execution.

description: How much code and conceptual overhead the prototype needs for the scenario.
observation_method: Inspect implementation size, abstractions, and number of moving parts.

description: How reliably the implementation returns the required JSON and Markdown formats.
observation_method: Inspect generated output files and parse status.
rating_scale: 1 = unreliable or missing, 5 = complete and consistent

description: How suitable the framework appears for the selected small academic task.
observation_method: Interpret observed implementation behavior, setup effort, and result quality after running.
